tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Where heidi.living has furnished monthly homes in Los Angeles: each region with its page, its description, and its neighborhoods, saying which have an application search on heidi.living and which are coming soon.

tools.name: application_link
tools.description: A link to heidi.living's application page, filled in with a guest's area, move-in date, length of stay and number of guests. The guest opens it, signs in and applies; every value stays editable there.

tools.name: faq
tools.description: heidi.living's answers to the questions guests ask before applying: what it is, what applying needs, how long a stay is, signing, paying rent, and what happens to a driver's license.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_regions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
